dedupeText: social realist billboard collage 1930s social realism billboard juxtaposition great depression aesthetic hand painted signage urban landscape foreground figures in a horizontal queue contrasting with the large scale billboard background vibrant saturated colors of the advertisement versus the muted earthy tones of the real world figures the upward slanted script of the billboard slogan cutting across the central car imagery the architectural grid of the city buildings framing the top of the composition juxtapose idealized commercial imagery with gritty social reality using hand painted billboard aesthetic and high contrast typography

retrievalProfile.description: A stark juxtaposition of a cheerful, idealized billboard advertisement featuring a smiling family in a car against a foreground of a somber, monochromatic line of people in coats.
excludeWhen: bright pop art without social subtext

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a large, hand-painted billboard depicting a white family in a blue car with optimistic slogans, positioned behind a realistic, desaturated line of diverse individuals standing in a queue, set against a backdrop of industrial city buildings.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground figures in a horizontal queue contrasting with the large-scale billboard background
Vibrant, saturated colors of the advertisement versus the muted, earthy tones of the real-world figures
The upward-slanted script of the billboard slogan cutting across the central car imagery
The architectural grid of the city buildings framing the top of the composition
coreInvariants: The visual irony between the 'American Dream' advertisement and the reality of the queue below it

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The billboard occupies the upper two-thirds of the frame; the queue of people occupies the bottom third at a smaller relative scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large blue car and the smiling faces within the billboard act as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bold yellow text at the top, down to the script slogan, and finally settles on the rhythmic line of figures at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with figures, text, and architectural details.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted browns, greys, and blacks for the foreground figures and city background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright sky blue and saturated greens within the billboard illustration.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow for the top display text and stark white for the script slogan.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the 'dream' imagery; low saturation and high value contrast in the 'reality' imagery.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or digital-first colors; maintain a mid-century painted feel.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and expressive brush script
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Wide, blocky, geometric capitals with thick black outlines.
Slogan text: Fluid, upward-slanting brush script with varying stroke weights and connected characters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the script has a large, sweeping crossbar that leads into the following letters.
The block letters have rounded corners and a slight 3D shadow effect.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of rigid, authoritative block capitals with informal, optimistic brush script.
graphicDevices: Horizontal red and blue stripes bordering the billboard
Halftone-like texture on the painted surfaces

preserve: The upward slant of the script
The yellow-with-black-outline treatment of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric weight of the top display text.
Captures the mid-century advertising brush feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a social realist painting of a 1930s bread line in front of a large, colorful billboard. The billboard shows a happy family in a blue car. The background features grey industrial buildings.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold yellow block capitals with black outlines at the very top. Add a large, white, upward-slanting brush script slogan on the right side of the billboard.

verificationChecks: Is there a clear contrast between the colorful billboard and the muted queue?
Does the script text slant upwards at an angle?
Are the foreground figures wearing mid-century coats and hats?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the queue
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the busy background.
Check that the scale of the billboard feels massive compared to the people.
Verify the color palette maintains the 'dream vs reality' distinction.
Confirm the brush script feels hand-painted rather than typeset.
recipe.reuseFormula: Juxtapose [Idealized Commercial Imagery] with [Gritty Social Reality] using [Hand-Painted Billboard Aesthetic] and [High-Contrast Typography].
